notes: This contract pins the embedded transport fault path to the Requirements Lab's explicit Connection Lost requirements. The private loopback endpoint drives the same failure handler a future remote transport will use; Catch2 verifies the official callback, forced Not Connected lifecycle, membership removal, reconnect boundary, and configured DELETE_OBJECTS, UNCONDITIONALLY_DIVEST_ATTRIBUTES, DELETE_OBJECTS_THEN_DIVEST, CANCEL_PENDING_OWNERSHIP_ACQUISITIONS, and CANCEL_THEN_DELETE_THEN_DIVEST Automatic Resign Directive dispositions through the official support-service setter. The closest Lab candidate for the required auto-resign step ends before its continuation names the directive; RL-060 records that extraction limitation. It is source/test traceability only, not protected-review evidence, a production transport claim, or conformance evidence.
